name: Infinity Natural Resources
outlook:
What Infinity Natural Resources says to expect

  • Full year 2026: capital spending and productionNet capital expenditures related to development activities, including drilling and completions and midstream, are expected to be between $450 million and $475 million. Net production is expected to be between 355 and 375 MMcfe/d for 2026, with natural gas expected to be between 235 and 245 MMcfe/d and oil and liquids expected to be between 20 and 22 Mbbls/d.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 9, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
